credits.title: Mysaa
credits.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

credits.title: Tiger Nageswara Rao
credits.overview: Based on the life of the notorious thief Nageswara Rao, who was the most wanted thief of south India& managed to evade the authorities on several occasions in the 1970s, earning him the moniker of 'Tiger.'

credits.title: Raakshasa Kaavyam
credits.overview: Ajay is a contract killer who has immense respect for students, and on the other hand, Vijay wants to make films highlighting antagonists. What happens when the duo go about realizing their goals with mad determination?
